query: 结社自由与集体谈判 结社自由与集体谈判 衡量企业保障员工自愿组建、加入工会等组织，并以此与雇主进行有关薪酬、福利、工作条件等事项集体协商权利的程度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：发布了明确的结社自由声明，包含“禁止打压/歧视工会代表”的专项条款；具备完善的集体谈判争议处理流程；披露了具体的集体合同关键条款及审议机制。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的政策承诺，具备工会或职工代表大会（职代会）组织，但缺乏深度的禁止打压机制说明或具体的集体协商争议解决程序。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视沟通”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：相关政策及集体合同覆盖 >80% 的员工或经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在国内主体执行而未覆盖海外子公司，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 结社自由 集体谈判 工会 集体合同 职工代表大会 劳资协商 禁止打压工会代表 集体协商 freedom of association collective bargaining trade union collective agreement works council labour-management negotiation non-retaliation against union representatives 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '结社自由与集体谈判'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工活动或文体协会；仅有“重视沟通”表述；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有申诉热线而无结社/集体谈判内容；区分：本指标关注结社自由与集体谈判权利；员工申诉机制是个体投诉渠道；童工/强迫劳动政策是人权底线禁令，不能替代集体谈判披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

In recruitment, we oppose employment discrimination and offer equal employment opportunities for employees regardless ofsns t c r s s s ity of talents, and create a harmonious and inclusive workplace. In the process of employment, we legally examine the identity information of candidates to avoid child and forced labor, and protect the rights of employees including privacy. During COVID-19 control period, we pay wages and so cial insurance as usual for employees under home quarantine. results.text: Occupational health and safety training: We provide regular training on work safety to enhance the occupational health awareness of employees. We carry out inspections on occupational disease prevention and control to ensure that labor protection articles are fully equipped and occupational disease prevention measures are implemented as required. We also organize employees to learn Baduanjin qigong(one of the most common forms of Chinese qigong used as exercise. It is primarily designated as a form of medical qigong, meant to improve health), hold activities including occupational health publicity week and being occupational health experts, and produce a series of occupational health micro videos, creating an environment for occupational health and safety.
